body:
I notice the dark alleyways beyond the depot where stray dogs have always found their homes. Their eyes dart around nervously as they search for scraps or safety. My heart tightens at the sight of the person feeding them. I can't help but think of how cruel it must be for these animals, caught in this cycle without any hope of rescue.

I swallow hard, knowing my feelings might come across as aggressive if I say anything now. But I can't stand by and watch another innocent suffer.
